plugins.name: claude-code-studios
plugins.description: Full software studio for Claude Code: 45 specialist agents across game AND app/web/service development, 90 workflow skills, and production hooks covering pre-production through live-ops. v0.6.7 fixes what was installed but never reached the model: PostToolUse advisories now arrive as additionalContext instead of stderr the model never sees (hooks/lib/emit-context.sh), five global rules documented as always active are finally printed at session start, and a missing skillListingBudgetFraction is flagged because at the default budget the team-*, start, sprint-* and story-* skills lost their descriptions and stopped auto-triggering. Projects can also opt in to delegated decision authority with a '## 결정 권한' section in their CLAUDE.md (rules/decision-lifecycle.md § 4.1); without it the user still makes the final call. (v0.6.6 added the install-registry gate; v0.6.5 gave the runtime split an actual reader.)
